name: Zabud
overview: Zabud is a male figure mentioned in the Bible as the son of Nathan and a friend of King Solomon. His role is briefly noted in 1 Kings 4:5, highlighting his close association with the royal court during Solomon's reign. There is no additional tribal or personal information recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Zabud means '[he has] bestowed upon,' which may reflect a sense of divine blessing or provision. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries a meaningful Hebrew significance as recorded in 1 Kings 4:5.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Zabud as the son of Nathan, establishing his family connection. Beyond this father-son relationship, no further family ties or descendants are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zabud's significance lies in his close friendship with King Solomon, suggesting he held a position of trust and influence during Solomon's rule. Being the son of Nathan, Zabud is linked to a respected lineage, which may have contributed to his standing at court. His mention in 1 Kings 4:5, though brief, places him among notable figures who supported Solomon's governance.
